Ou0a538-uuJAAdxq9IEX1A.en: Nauru has an outbreak: as of 18 August this year, 379 cases had been cumulatively reported, and two deaths were reported on 30 July. 77% of cases are aged 18 or under. Cases are mainly distributed in Meneng, Denigomodu, Aiwo, Boe and Baiti districts. Samoa's outbreak update: as of 17 August this year, 3,070 confirmed cases and six deaths had been cumulatively reported. 91% of cases came from Upolu Island, and the main serotype detected is DENV-1.
